name: Dirty Grandpa
source:
[b]Dirty Grandpa[/b] is a visual novel where you experience the life of a college professor at a top college. Problems arise when he gets sick and [b]is on the verge of death[/b]. Fortunately he survived, thanks to the demon Lilith, [b]but at what cost[/b]?

Can you help Grandpa navigate the terms set by the demon, [b]or will he die[/b]?

[From [url=https://latenightstudios.itch.io/dirty-grandpa]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
[b]肮脏爷爷[/b]是一部视觉小说，你可以在其中体验顶尖大学教授的生活。当他生病并且[b]濒临死亡[/b]时，问题就出现了。幸运的是，多亏了恶魔莉莉丝，他活了下来，[b]但代价是什么[/b]？

你能帮助爷爷应对恶魔设定的条款吗，[b]否则他会死[/b]？

[来自[url=https://latenightstudios.itch.io/dirty-grandpa]Itch.io[/url]]
